testcase.name: Scenario: Retain staged command display options when switching targets: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1153:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain staged command display options when switching targets ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And ribbon customization is open with "All Commands" selected ✔ And the Part | Tools and Part | Manage custom targets are empty ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the Part | Tools target without applying ✔ And the user checks Large and Text for that command ✔ And the user selects the Part | Manage target ✔ Then the Part | Manage target list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user returns to the Part | Tools target ✔ Then "2D Sketches" remains in the target list ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ And the target is marked as changed ✔ And Apply and cancels are enabled ✔ When the user cancels customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
